description_en: Returns a paginated list of roles in a workspace
description_zh: 分页查询工作空间角色详情
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-project-roles --project-id 21229 --codes role_project_guest --names Visitors --type System --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProjectRoles

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can find the ID on the Workspace Management page in the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for which you want to list roles.
parameters.description_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。
